Directed tests cover reset, register access, detection, clearing, acknowledge and claim. Assertions cover the combinational rules for read, mask, priority and latency, plus a no-set check for clearing writes. Cover points cover the mode and enable cross, acknowledge IDs and the set-versus-clear collision. A randomised scoreboard test is also planned. === FILE: verification_plan.json ===
{
  "format": "nirmaan.vplan",
  "version": 1,
  "requirements": [
    {"id": "IRQ-PARAM", "section": "1", "source": "interface_spec.md", "text": "The block works for every `N` from 2 to 32, and bits `N` and up of the `ENABLE`, `MODE` and `PENDING` registers read as zero and ignore writes."},
    {"id": "IRQ-RESET", "section": "4.1", "source": "interface_spec.md", "text": "While `rst_n` is low at a rising edge of `clk`, `ENABLE`, `MODE` and `PENDING` clear to zero and the remembered level of every source clears to zero."},
    {"id": "IRQ-REG-RW", "section": "4.1", "source": "interface_spec.md", "text": "A write to `ENABLE` or `MODE` stores `wdata` bits `N-1` to 0 in that register."},
    {"id": "IRQ-READ", "section": "4.1", "source": "interface_spec.md", "text": "A read never changes any register; `rdata` follows `addr` with no clock edge."},
    {"id": "IRQ-LEVEL", "section": "4.2", "source": "interface_spec.md", "text": "A high-level source sets its `PENDING` bit at every rising edge where its input is high."},
    {"id": "IRQ-EDGE", "section": "4.2", "source": "interface_spec.md", "text": "A rising-edge source sets its `PENDING` bit at a rising edge where its input is high and was low at the previous rising edge, so an input held high sets it once."},
    {"id": "IRQ-DETECT-DISABLED", "section": "4.2", "source": "interface_spec.md", "text": "Detection does not depend on `ENABLE`: a disabled source still sets its `PENDING` bit."},
    {"id": "IRQ-W1C", "section": "4.3", "source": "interface_spec.md", "text": "A write to `PENDING` clears each bit written 1 and leaves each bit written 0 unchanged; it never sets a bit."},
    {"id": "IRQ-ACK", "section": "4.3", "source": "interface_spec.md", "text": "A write to `CLAIM` acknowledges the source whose number is in `wdata` bits 4 to 0: that source's `PENDING` bit clears and no other bit changes; a number of `N` or more changes nothing."},
    {"id": "IRQ-SET-WINS", "section": "4.3", "source": "interface_spec.md", "text": "A source detected at the same rising edge as a write that clears its bit keeps its `PENDING` bit set, so a high-level source acknowledged while its input is still high stays pending."},
    {"id": "IRQ-MASK", "section": "4.4", "source": "interface_spec.md", "text": "`irq` is high exactly when some source has both its `PENDING` and its `ENABLE` bit set, for high-level and rising-edge sources alike."},
    {"id": "IRQ-PRIORITY", "section": "4.4", "source": "interface_spec.md", "text": "`irq_id` is the lowest-numbered source whose `PENDING` and `ENABLE` bits are both set, so source 0 has the highest priority, and it is 0 while `irq` is low."},
    {"id": "IRQ-CLAIM", "section": "4.4", "source": "interface_spec.md", "text": "A read of `CLAIM` returns `irq` in bit 31 and `irq_id` in bits 4 to 0, with every other bit zero."},
    {"id": "IRQ-LATENCY", "section": "4.4", "source": "interface_spec.md", "text": "`irq` and `irq_id` follow the registers with no clock edge, so a source detected at one rising edge drives `irq` until the next."}
  ],
  "items": [
    {"id": "T-PARAM", "kind": "test", "file": "tb_irq_ctrl.sv", "name": "test_param_unused_bits", "proves": ["IRQ-PARAM"], "rationale": "Run with N = 2, 8 and 32. Write all ones to ENABLE, MODE and PENDING and drive every source. Check that register bits N to 31 read zero and that a write to them has no effect. Every other directed test is also rerun at these N values."},
    {"id": "T-RESET", "kind": "test", "file": "tb_irq_ctrl.sv", "name": "test_reset", "proves": ["IRQ-RESET"], "rationale": "Load ENABLE, MODE and PENDING with nonzero values and hold edge sources high, then assert rst_n low for one edge. Check that all three registers read zero. Next, release reset with an edge source still high and check that it is detected as a rising edge, which shows the remembered level was cleared."},
    {"id": "T-REG-RW", "kind": "test", "file": "tb_irq_ctrl.sv", "name": "test_register_rw", "proves": ["IRQ-REG-RW", "IRQ-READ"], "rationale": "Write walking-one, walking-zero and random patterns to ENABLE and MODE, and read each back. Check that bits N-1 to 0 match wdata and that rdata changes with addr in the same cycle, without a clock edge."},
    {"id": "A-READ", "kind": "assertion", "file": "irq_ctrl_sva.sv", "name": "a_read_no_side_effect", "proves": ["IRQ-READ"], "rationale": "On cycles where we is low, no register changes except through PENDING detection. rdata is always equal to the register that addr selects."},
    {"id": "T-LEVEL", "kind": "test", "file": "tb_irq_ctrl.sv", "name": "test_level_detect", "proves": ["IRQ-LEVEL"], "rationale": "With MODE at 0, hold a source high. Clear PENDING with a write and check that the bit is set again at the next edge while the input stays high. Check that a low input does not set the bit."},
    {"id": "T-EDGE", "kind": "test", "file": "tb_irq_ctrl.sv", "name": "test_edge_detect", "proves": ["IRQ-EDGE"], "rationale": "With MODE at 1, drive a rising edge and check that PENDING sets. Clear the bit while the input stays high and check that it does not set again. Drive low and then high, and check that it sets again."},
    {"id": "T-DETECT-DIS", "kind": "test", "file": "tb_irq_ctrl.sv", "name": "test_detect_disabled", "proves": ["IRQ-DETECT-DISABLED"], "rationale": "With ENABLE at 0, trigger level and edge sources. Check that the PENDING bits set and that irq stays low."},
    {"id": "T-W1C", "kind": "test", "file": "tb_irq_ctrl.sv", "name": "test_pending_w1c", "proves": ["IRQ-W1C"], "rationale": "Set several pending bits, then write mixed patterns to PENDING while the sources are idle. Check that only the bits written 1 clear, and that writing 1 to a bit that is not pending leaves it clear."},
    {"id": "A-W1C-NOSET", "kind": "assertion", "file": "irq_ctrl_sva.sv", "name": "a_write_never_sets_pending", "proves": ["IRQ-W1C", "IRQ-ACK"], "rationale": "A PENDING bit that rises on a write cycle must have a detection condition at that same edge."},
    {"id": "T-ACK", "kind": "test", "file": "tb_irq_ctrl.sv", "name": "test_claim_ack", "proves": ["IRQ-ACK"], "rationale": "Set several pending bits and acknowledge each ID through CLAIM. Check that only the named bit clears. Write IDs from N to 31 and check that nothing changes. Include values with wdata bits above bit 4 set, to confirm that only bits 4 to 0 are used."},
    {"id": "T-SET-WINS", "kind": "test", "file": "tb_irq_ctrl.sv", "name": "test_set_wins_over_clear", "proves": ["IRQ-SET-WINS"], "rationale": "Acknowledge a high-level source, and separately W1C it, while its input is high, and check that it stays pending. Repeat with a rising edge that arrives on the same edge as the clearing write."},
    {"id": "A-MASK", "kind": "assertion", "file": "irq_ctrl_sva.sv", "name": "a_irq_equals_pending_and_enable", "proves": ["IRQ-MASK"], "rationale": "irq is always equal to the OR-reduction of (PENDING & ENABLE), whatever MODE is."},
    {"id": "A-PRIORITY", "kind": "assertion", "file": "irq_ctrl_sva.sv", "name": "a_irq_id_lowest_set", "proves": ["IRQ-PRIORITY"], "rationale": "irq_id is always the index of the lowest set bit of PENDING & ENABLE, and 0 when there is none."},
    {"id": "T-CLAIM", "kind": "test", "file": "tb_irq_ctrl.sv", "name": "test_claim_read", "proves": ["IRQ-CLAIM", "IRQ-PRIORITY"], "rationale": "Set several enabled pending sources and read CLAIM. Check that bit 31 is irq, bits 4 to 0 are the lowest enabled pending ID, and every other bit is 0. Also read CLAIM with irq low."},
    {"id": "A-LATENCY", "kind": "assertion", "file": "irq_ctrl_sva.sv", "name": "a_irq_combinational", "proves": ["IRQ-LATENCY", "IRQ-MASK"], "rationale": "At every sampling point, irq and irq_id match the current register values with no added cycle delay. This includes the first cycle after detection."},
    {"id": "T-RANDOM", "kind": "test", "file": "tb_irq_ctrl.sv", "name": "test_random_scoreboard", "proves": ["IRQ-REG-RW", "IRQ-LEVEL", "IRQ-EDGE", "IRQ-W1C", "IRQ-ACK", "IRQ-SET-WINS", "IRQ-MASK", "IRQ-PRIORITY", "IRQ-CLAIM"], "rationale": "Constrained-random sources and register accesses, checked every cycle against a reference model of the spec."},
    {"id": "C-MODE-ENABLE", "kind": "coverage_point", "file": "irq_ctrl_cov.sv", "name": "cg_mode_x_enable", "proves": ["IRQ-MASK", "IRQ-DETECT-DISABLED"], "rationale": "Covers each source crossed with MODE (level or edge), ENABLE (0 or 1) and detection."},
    {"id": "C-COLLISION", "kind": "coverage_point", "file": "irq_ctrl_cov.sv", "name": "cg_set_clear_collision", "proves": ["IRQ-SET-WINS", "IRQ-ACK"], "rationale": "Covers detection on the same edge as a W1C or CLAIM write, and ACK IDs both below and at or above N."}
  ]
}
=== END FILE ===
